heading: Optional privacy choices
body: Turn configured Google services on or off for this browser. Regional consent requirements also apply in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland. The reading works without them.
analyticsDescription: Keep limited page and feature-use measurement on so the product can improve. Regional consent controls still apply.
advertisingDescription: Keep Google AdSense on for approved non-reading content pages. Regional consent controls still apply.
storageError: We couldn't save your choices. Try again in this panel so they can be applied safely.
